headline: Brand impairments crater profit as sales hold steady
summary_short: Revenue was $912M, down 13.6% q/q and 1.3% y/y; net income fell 79.8% q/q to $54M after $132M in non-cash Gin Mare and Diplomático brand impairments taken this quarter.
summary_long: Fiscal Q4 (year ended April 30, 2026) revenue was $912M, down 13.6% q/q and 1.3% y/y. Gross profit rose 3.4% y/y to $571M on favorable FX and lower costs, but operating income fell 33.5% q/q to $228M and net income dropped 79.8% q/q to $54M, driven by $132M in non-cash Gin Mare ($45M) and Diplomático ($87M) brand impairments from the annual test, plus an adverse earn-out valuation swing. Full-year net sales were $3.9B (-1%) and diluted EPS $1.53 (-17%). FY2027 guidance: organic net sales flat, organic operating income down 3-5%, capex $60-70M. Cash fell to $308M after $400M buybacks and $427M dividends.
